children: Titan Company Limited (NSE:TITAN) posted strong Q2 growth across domestic (+22%) and international (+97%) lines and product segments while mixed festival timing and weak gold‑coin demand pressured near‑term revenue and shares, as analysts remain positive with ₹5,510–₹5,700 targets.
Previous Week Recap
Titan Buy/Outperform Targets
: Analysts gave Titan (TITAN) Buy/Outperform/Overweight ratings with targets ₹5,510–₹5,700. They noted festival-season shift hit quarterly revenue but may boost medium-term growth and margins.
Domestic +22%, International +97%
: Titan (TITAN) Q2: domestic sales +22% YoY, international +97%, consumer +25%, watches +30%, Eye Care +28%. Shares fell ~3.8% in early trade; slower consumer growth noted in September quarter.
Gold Coin Sales Drop
: Titan Company (TITAN) reported weaker gold coin sales this quarter and said excluding investment-driven gold coins would boost core jewellery growth by about 5–8 percentage points.
RSI Under 30; Key Supports
: TITAN: RSI dropped under 30; broke support near ₹4,600 (200-week EMA). Next support ~₹4,200; value-buy zone ₹4,150–₹4,000. Avoid new longs until stabilization signs.
Studded Jewellery Growth Drives Jewellery
: TITAN Q2 FY2027: studded jewellery sales rose low–mid 30% YoY (vs 27% in Q1), helping drive overall jewellery growth of about 21% for the quarter.
Festivals Drive Near-Term Demand
: Titan (TITAN) sees near-term demand boost from festivals and weddings. Organised jewellery is 38–40% of sales. Future share gains tied to consumer behavior and gold-price uncertainty.
Retail Brands Growth Noted
: Titan Company (TITAN) retail brands: Tanishq, Mia, Zoya and beYon rose ~20% QoQ; CaratLane grew ~32% QoQ — reported sales growth for the quarter.
Tanishq Natural Diamonds Sourcing
: TITAN highlights education and transparency in diamond selection and sourcing for Tanishq Natural Diamonds to boost credibility and support premiumisation in India’s organised jewelry market.
Signature Couture Edit Debut

: Titan Company (TITAN) showcased the Signature Couture Edit, a high‑jewelry line with Rahul Mishra featuring natural diamonds and colored gems; debuted at Paris Couture Week 2026 and shown in Mumbai.
